body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

However, unlike https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/104178, I can't reproduce any performance improvement in TPS demo startup/shutdown times. It's even a tiny bit slower on average, but this is likely within margin of error.

## Benchmark

<details open>

<summary>PC specifications</summary>

- **CPU:** Intel Core i9-13900K
- **GPU:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090
- **RAM:** 64 GB (2×32 GB DDR5-5800 C30)
- **SSD:** Solidigm P44 Pro 2 TB
- **OS:** Linux (Fedora 41)
</details>

Using release optimized export templates (`production=yes lto=full`). Measuring startup + shutdown times on the TPS demo's main menu:

```
❯ hyperfine -m50 -iw1 \
"bin/godot.linuxbsd.template_release.x86_64.master --path ~/Documents/Godot/tps-demo --audio-driver Dummy --quit" \
"bin/godot.linuxbsd.template_release.x86_64 --path ~/Documents/Godot/tps-demo --audio-driver Dummy --quit"
Benchmark 1: bin/godot.linuxbsd.template_release.x86_64.master --path ~/Documents/Godot/tps-demo --audio-driver Dummy --quit
  Time (mean ± σ):      2.165 s ±  0.411 s    [User: 0.377 s, System: 0.411 s]
  Range (min … max):    1.660 s …  2.731 s    50 runs
 
Benchmark 2: bin/godot.linuxbsd.template_release.x86_64 --path ~/Documents/Godot/tps-demo --audio-driver Dummy --quit
  Time (mean ± σ):      2.209 s ±  0.427 s    [User: 0.373 s, System: 0.412 s]
  Range (min … max):    1.605 s …  2.740 s    50 runs
 
Summary
  bin/godot.linuxbsd.template_release.x86_64.master --path ~/Documents/Godot/tps-demo --audio-driver Dummy --quit ran
    1.02 ± 0.28 times faster than bin/godot.linuxbsd.template_release.x86_64 --path ~/Documents/Godot/tps-demo --audio-driver Dummy --quit
```
